gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-vai: Big, scattered, loud letters with hollow-reed counters that open right up. Noto Sans Vai takes the quiet job, setting words as solid blocks with generous gaps where curves meet stems, while Paprika makes the noise.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Paprika lets its far-apart letters loom, with counters like a hollow reed cut open. Noto Sans Vithkuqi does the tidy work, with open throats in its lowercase and hardly any step down from capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-onest: Letters scattered at a distance give Paprika a loud, hollow-reed look, with the lowercase standing as tall as capitals would. Onest then lets the page settle, its curves flowing without any ink pooling.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-orienta: Paprika spaces its letters far apart, with lowercase standing tall as capitals and counters like a hollow reed cut open. Orienta reads smoothly for paragraphs, its cases nearly level in height.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-prompt: Loud letters, spaced far apart, with counters like hollow reeds. Paprika is best at commanding attention, while Prompt is best at being read, its oversized small letters and open apertures staying legible.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-questrial: Expressive and loud, Paprika spaces its letters at a distance, counters breathing like a hollow reed. Questrial keeps to flat, single-weight strokes and a tall band of letters with short stalks, leaving the drama to Paprika.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-radio-canada: Paprika is all swagger, with widely scattered letters and hollow-reed counters. Radio Canada works beneath it with lowercase c, s and z standing tall and full, drawn in plain unshaded lines that stay quiet.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-readex-pro: Paprika is loud on purpose, with scattered letters and hollow-reed counters. Give it generous size, and let Readex Pro, a sans with broad terminal gaps and unvarying weight, handle everything smaller.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-roboto: Brash, spaced-out letters with hollow-reed counters give Paprika a loud look, while Roboto has generous mouths on its round letters. Give Paprika the big sizes and Roboto the small ones.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sono: Barely-there ascenders give Love Ya Like A Sister its bold, expressive look. That bold face pays off big and brief, while Sono, with wide default spacing, carries the rest.
